proxy_outdated.title: The Blink proxy is older than this integration needs
proxy_outdated.description:
The proxy at {base_url} reports {proxy_version}. This integration needs {minimum_version} or newer.

Live view, clips and push-to-talk keep working. What fails is anything the newer proxy added — browser authentication answers 404, because those routes have never existed in that build.

The two halves update independently: HACS moves the integration, and nothing moves the proxy. On a Linux service install, run this on the proxy host from a checkout of the repository:

```
sudo scripts/install-proxy.sh
```

It keeps your token, config and Blink session, and restarts the service. Add-on installs update from the add-on store.

This notice clears itself once the proxy reports {minimum_version} or newer.
